```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(sportyR)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4) 
library(splines)
library(viridis)
library(glue)

df_shots <- read_csv("df_shots.csv") |>
  dplyr::select(-`...1`) |>
  mutate(shot_type = if_else(str_detect(text, "three point") | shot_dist > 25, 3, 2),
         scoring_play = as.integer(scoring_play))
head(df_shots)

df_shots |>
  filter((team_id == 17 & season == 2022) | (team_id == 17 & season == 2023) | (team_id == 9 & season == 2024)) |>
  summarize(n_games = n_distinct(game_id),
            n_shots = n())
```

```{r}
# function that returns basic streak statistics given a sequence
streak_stats = function(results_sequence, streak_length){
  n_trials = length(results_sequence)
  n_success = sum(results_sequence)
  
  run_lengths = rle(results_sequence)$lengths
  if_run_success = rle(results_sequence)$values
  n_runs = length(run_lengths)
  
  # runs of successes
  longest_run_success = max(run_lengths*if_run_success)
  n_runs_success = sum(if_run_success)
  
  # successes after streaks of Successes
  run_lengths_adj = run_lengths - streak_length + 1
  run_values_adj_S =
    if_run_success *
    (!((if_run_success == 1) &
         (run_lengths < streak_length)))
  n_after_Sstreak = sum(run_lengths_adj * run_values_adj_S) -
    run_values_adj_S[length(run_values_adj_S)]
  n_success_after_Sstreak = sum((run_lengths - streak_length) * run_values_adj_S)
  
  # runs of failures
  longest_run_failure = max(run_lengths*(1-if_run_success))
  n_runs_failure = sum(1-if_run_success)
  
  # successes after streaks of Failures
  run_values_adj_F =
    (1-if_run_success) *
    (!((if_run_success == 0) &
         (run_lengths < streak_length)))
  n_after_Fstreak = sum(run_lengths_adj * run_values_adj_F) -
    run_values_adj_F[length(run_values_adj_F)]
  n_success_after_Fstreak = n_after_Fstreak -
    sum((run_lengths - streak_length) * run_values_adj_F)
  
  # Proportion of hits on trials after streaks
  phat_after_Sstreak = n_success_after_Sstreak / n_after_Sstreak
  
  # Difference in proportion of hits (trials after streaks - all other trials)
  phat_after_no_Sstreak = (n_success - n_success_after_Sstreak)/
    (n_trials - n_after_Sstreak)
  phat_Sstreak_vs_others = phat_after_Sstreak - phat_after_no_Sstreak
  
  # Difference in proportion of hits (trials after hit streaks - trials after miss streaks)
  phat_after_Fstreak = n_success_after_Fstreak / n_after_Fstreak
  phat_Sstreak_vs_Fstreak = phat_after_Sstreak - phat_after_Fstreak
  
  # Hit streak frequency - proportion of trials that occur after hit streaks
  Sstreak_frequency  = n_after_Sstreak / (n_trials - streak_length)
  
  # collect the streak stats for the results sequence
  return(data.frame(phat_after_Sstreak,
                    phat_Sstreak_vs_others,
                    phat_Sstreak_vs_Fstreak,
                    Sstreak_frequency,
                    longest_run_success,
                    n_runs
                    #                     n_runs_success,
                    #                     phat_after_Fstreak,
                    #                     n_runs_failure,
                    #                     longest_run_failure,
  ))
}

# For only Sstreak - others
phat_Sstreak_vs_others <- function(results_sequence, streak_length){
  n_trials = length(results_sequence)
  n_success = sum(results_sequence)
  
  run_lengths = rle(results_sequence)$lengths
  if_run_success = rle(results_sequence)$values
  
  # successes after streaks of Successes
  run_lengths_adj = run_lengths - streak_length + 1
  run_values_adj_S =
    if_run_success *
    (!((if_run_success == 1) &
         (run_lengths < streak_length)))
  n_after_Sstreak = sum(run_lengths_adj * run_values_adj_S) -
    run_values_adj_S[length(run_values_adj_S)]
  n_success_after_Sstreak = sum((run_lengths - streak_length) * run_values_adj_S)
  
  if (n_after_Sstreak <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  if ((n_trials - n_after_Sstreak) <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  phat_after_Sstreak = n_success_after_Sstreak / n_after_Sstreak
  phat_after_Sstreak
  
  phat_after_no_Sstreak = (n_success - n_success_after_Sstreak)/
    (n_trials - n_after_Sstreak)
  
  phat_after_Sstreak - phat_after_no_Sstreak
}

# For only Sstreak - Fstreak
phat_Sstreak_Fstreak <- function(results_sequence, streak_length){
  n_trials = length(results_sequence)
  n_success = sum(results_sequence)
  
  run_lengths = rle(results_sequence)$lengths
  if_run_success = rle(results_sequence)$values
  
  # successes after streaks of Successes
  run_lengths_adj = run_lengths - streak_length + 1
  run_values_adj_S =
    if_run_success *
    (!((if_run_success == 1) &
         (run_lengths < streak_length)))
  n_after_Sstreak = sum(run_lengths_adj * run_values_adj_S) -
    run_values_adj_S[length(run_values_adj_S)]
  n_success_after_Sstreak = sum((run_lengths - streak_length) * run_values_adj_S)
  
  # successes after streaks of Failures
  run_values_adj_F =
    (1-if_run_success) *
    (!((if_run_success == 0) &
         (run_lengths < streak_length)))
  n_after_Fstreak = sum(run_lengths_adj * run_values_adj_F) -
    run_values_adj_F[length(run_values_adj_F)]
  n_success_after_Fstreak = n_after_Fstreak -
    sum((run_lengths - streak_length) * run_values_adj_F)
  
  phat_after_Sstreak = n_success_after_Sstreak / n_after_Sstreak
  phat_after_Fstreak = n_success_after_Fstreak / n_after_Fstreak
  phat_Sstreak_vs_Fstreak = phat_after_Sstreak - phat_after_Fstreak
  
  phat_Sstreak_vs_Fstreak
  
}

# For only Sstreak
phat_Sstreak <- function(results_sequence, streak_length){
  
  n_trials = length(results_sequence)
  n_success = sum(results_sequence)
  
  run_lengths = rle(results_sequence)$lengths
  if_run_success = rle(results_sequence)$values
  
  # successes after streaks of Successes
  run_lengths_adj = run_lengths - streak_length + 1
  run_values_adj_S =
    if_run_success *
    (!((if_run_success == 1) &
         (run_lengths < streak_length)))
  n_after_Sstreak = sum(run_lengths_adj * run_values_adj_S) -
    run_values_adj_S[length(run_values_adj_S)]
  n_success_after_Sstreak = sum((run_lengths - streak_length) * run_values_adj_S)
  
  phat_after_Sstreak = n_success_after_Sstreak / n_after_Sstreak
  phat_after_Sstreak
}
```



```{r}
set.seed(619)

# grab one season data
pull_list_games <- function(shots_df, TEAMID, SEASON){
  shots_df |>
    filter(team_id == TEAMID,
         season == SEASON) |>
  mutate(shot_made = as.integer(scoring_play)) |>
  select(game_id, time_elapsed, shot_made) |>
    group_by(game_id) |>
    group_split()
}

# grab lv 2022, lv 2023, ny 2024 (champs each season)
lv_2022_games <- pull_list_games(df_shots, 17, 2022)
lv_2023_games <- pull_list_games(df_shots, 17, 2023)
ny_2024_games <- pull_list_games(df_shots, 9, 2024)

# number of permutations to run for each game
n_trials <- 10000

# iterate over all games in the list
# take a random permutation of the shots in game, compute statistic
perm_stats_2022 <- lv_2022_games |> map(~replicate(
    n_trials,
    phat_Sstreak_Fstreak(sample(.x$shot_made), 3)
  )
)

# plot all the games
map(perm_stats_2022, hist)
results_2022 <- tibble(
  game_id = map_int(lv_2022_games, ~ .x$game_id[1]),
  observed = map_dbl(lv_2022_games, ~ phat_Sstreak_Fstreak(.x$shot_made, 3)),
  perm_dist = perm_stats_2022
) |>
  mutate(
    p_value = map2_dbl(observed, perm_dist, ~ mean(.y >= .x, na.rm = T))
  )

results_2022 |>
  pull(p_value) |>
  hist()

results_2022 |>
  arrange(p_value) |>
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, "BH", n = nrow(results_2022))) |>
  select(game_id, observed, p_value, p_adj)

df_shots |> filter((team_id == 17 & season %in% c(2022, 2023)) | (team_id == 9 & season == 2024)) |> group_by(season, team_id, game_id) |>
    arrange(season, team_id) |>
    summarize(streak_stat = streak_stats(scoring_play, 3)) |>
  unnest_wider(streak_stat)

```

```{r}
set.seed(619)
perm_stats_2023 <- lv_2023_games |> map(~replicate(
    n_trials,
    phat_Sstreak_Fstreak(sample(.x$shot_made), 3)
  )
)

# plot all the games
map(perm_stats_2023, hist)
results_2023 <- tibble(
  game_id = map_int(lv_2023_games, ~ .x$game_id[1]),
  observed = map_dbl(lv_2023_games, ~ phat_Sstreak_Fstreak(.x$shot_made, 3)),
  perm_dist = perm_stats_2023
) |>
  mutate(
    p_value = map2_dbl(observed, perm_dist, ~ mean(.y >= .x, na.rm = T))
  )

results_2023 |>
  pull(p_value) |>
  hist()

results_2023 |>
  na.omit(p_value) |>
  arrange(p_value) |>
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, "BH")) |>
  select(game_id, observed, p_value, p_adj)

results_2023 |>
  mutate(
    perm_mean = map_dbl(perm_dist, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    bias_adj = observed - perm_mean
  ) |>
  select(game_id, p_value, bias_adj)
```

```{r, warning = F}
# fit GLM

glm_shots <- df_shots |>
  arrange(team_id, game_id, time_elapsed) |>
  group_by(team_id, game_id) |>
  mutate(
    miss_group = cumsum(lag(scoring_play, default = 0) == 0),  # resets after a miss
    streak = ave(scoring_play, miss_group, FUN = cumsum),      # running makes within streak
    after_3_makes = ifelse(lag(streak, default = 0) >= 3, 1, 0),
    
    make_group = cumsum(lag(scoring_play, default = 0) == 1),
    miss_streak = ave(1 - scoring_play, make_group, FUN = cumsum),
    after_3_misses = ifelse(lag(miss_streak, default = 0) >= 3, 1, 0),
    
    sequence_type = case_when(after_3_misses == 1 ~ 0,
                              after_3_makes == 1 ~ 1,
                              after_3_makes == 0 & after_3_misses == 0 ~ 2),
    streak_group = if_else(streak >= 3, "3+", "0-2"),
    streak_group = factor(streak_group, levels = c("0-2", "3+")),
    streak_group_2 = case_when(streak == 0 ~ "0",
                               streak == 1 ~ "1",
                               streak == 2 ~ "2",
                               streak == 3 ~ "3",
                               streak >= 4 ~ "4+"),
    streak_before = streak - scoring_play,
    streak_before = case_when(streak_before == 0 ~ "0",
                               streak_before == 1 ~ "1",
                               streak_before == 2 ~ "2",
                               streak_before >= 3 ~ "3+"),
    miss_streak_before = miss_streak - (1 - scoring_play),
miss_streak_before = case_when(
  miss_streak_before == 0 ~ "0",
  miss_streak_before == 1 ~ "1",
  miss_streak_before == 2 ~ "2",
  miss_streak_before >= 3 ~ "3+"
)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# null_model <- glm(scoring_play ~ factor(after_3_makes) + factor(shot_type) + factor(team_id) + time_elapsed, family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = glm_shots) 
# 

null_model <- glm(
    scoring_play ~ factor(shot_type) +
      time_elapsed +
      factor(team_id) + factor(season) + factor(season)*factor(team_id),
    family = binomial(),
    data = glm_shots
  )

summary(null_model)

phat <- predict(null_model, newdata = glm_shots, type = "response")

glm_shots_predicted <- glm_shots |>
  cbind(phat) |>
  relocate(scoring_play, phat)

head(glm_shots_predicted)

glm_shots |>
  ggplot(aes(x = shot_dist, color = streak_before)) + geom_density() + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Shot Density Conditional on Previous Shot Streak Length", y = "Proportion of Shots", x = "Shot Distance (ft)", color = "Streak length before shot")

# rest of league
glm_shots |>
  filter(
    !(
      (team_id == 17 & season %in% c(2022, 2023)) |
      (team_id == 9  & season == 2024)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = shot_dist, color = streak_before)) + geom_density() + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Shot Density Conditional on Previous Shot Streak Length", subtitle = "Rest of League 2022-2024", y = "Proportion of Shots", x = "Shot Distance (ft)", color = "Streak Length") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 60)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, .1))

# 2022 lv aces
glm_shots |>
  filter(season == 2022 & team_id == 17) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = shot_dist, color = streak_before)) + geom_density() + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Shot Density Conditional on Previous Shot Streak Length", subtitle = "LV Aces 2022", y = "Proportion of Shots", x = "Shot Distance (ft)", color = "Streak Length") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 60)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, .1))

# 2023 lv aces
glm_shots |>
  filter(season == 2023 & team_id == 17) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = shot_dist, color = streak_before)) + geom_density() + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Shot Density Conditional on Previous Shot Streak Length", subtitle = "LV Aces 2023", y = "Proportion of Shots", x = "Shot Distance (ft)", color = "Streak Length") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 60)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, .1))

# 2024 ny liberty
glm_shots |>
  filter(season == 2024 & team_id == 9) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = shot_dist, color = streak_before)) + geom_density() + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Shot Density Conditional on Previous Shot Streak Length", subtitle = "NY Liberty 2024", y = "Proportion of Shots", x = "Shot Distance (ft)", color = "Streak Length") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 60)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, .1))

glm_shots |>
  mutate(group = case_when(
      team_id == 17 & season == 2022 ~ "2022 LV Aces",
      team_id == 17 & season == 2023 ~ "2023 LV Aces",
      team_id == 9  & season == 2024 ~ "2024 NY Liberty",
      TRUE                           ~ "Rest of League"
    )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = shot_dist, color = streak_before, lty = streak_before)) + geom_density() + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Shot Density Conditional on Previous Shot Streak Length", y = "Proportion of Shots", x = "Shot Distance (ft)", color = "Streak Length", lty = "") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 60)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, .1)) + facet_wrap(~group) + guides(lty = "none") + scale_color_discrete(palette = "Okabe-Ito")

glm_shots |>
  ggplot(aes(x = shot_dist)) + geom_density() + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Shot Density Conditional on Previous Shot Streak Length", y = "Proportion of Shots", x = "Shot Distance (ft)", color = "Streak Length", lty = "") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 60)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, .1)) + facet_wrap(~streak_before)

glm_shots |>
  mutate(streak_before = if_else(streak_before == "3+", "3+", "< 3")) |>
  group_by(season, team_id, streak_before) |>
  summarize(shot_dist = mean(shot_dist)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = streak_before, values_from = shot_dist) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = `< 3`, y = `3+`)) + geom_point(aes(color = as.factor(season))) + geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ x, se = F) + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                                                                                                                                                                 legend.position = "bottom") + labs(x = "Streak length < 3", y = "Streak length 3+", title = "Average shot distance (ft)", color = "Season") + scale_color_discrete(palette = "Okabe-Ito") + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(11, 16)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(11, 16))
```

```{r}
set.seed(619)
n_sims = 10000

sim_results_2022 <- glm_shots_predicted |>
  filter(team_id == 17,
         season == 2022) |>
  arrange(game_id, sequence_number) |>
  group_by(game_id) |>
  summarize(
    observed_stat = phat_Sstreak_Fstreak(scoring_play, 3),
    
    sim_stats = list(
      replicate(
        n_sims,
        phat_Sstreak_Fstreak(
          rbinom(n = n(), size = 1, prob = phat),
          3
        )
      )
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  unnest_wider(sim_stats, names_sep = "_") |>
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0("sim_", seq_along(.)),
    starts_with("sim_stats_")
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    p_value = mean(c_across(starts_with("sim_")) >= observed_stat, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# results of simulations
sim_results_2022 |>
  select(-c(3:10002)) |>
  arrange(p_value)

p.adjust(sim_results_2022$p_value, method = "BH") |>
  cbind(sim_results_2022) |>
  select(-c(4:10003)) |>
  slice_min(p_value, n = 6)

# let's look at games that have low p-values
df_shots |>
  filter(team_id == 17,
         season == 2022,
         game_id %in% c(401391727, 
                        401391828, 
                        401391678,
                        401455683)) |>
  group_by(game_id) |>
  arrange(game_id, sequence_number) |>
  summarize(statistics = streak_stats(scoring_play, 3)) |>
  unnest_wider(statistics)

longer_2022 <- sim_results_2022 |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("sim_"),
    names_to = "simulation",
    values_to = "sim_value"
  )

sample_games <- sim_results_2022 |> 
  slice_min(p_value, n = 6) |>
  pull(game_id)

longer_2022 |> filter(game_id %in% sample_games) |>
  mutate(game_id = as_factor(game_id),
         game_id = game_id |> recode_values(
                "401391727" ~ "vs. LA Sparks",
                "401391828" ~ "vs. IN Fever",
                "401391678" ~ "vs. MN Lynx",
                "401455683" ~ "vs. CT Sun",
                "401391747" ~ "vs. CHI Sky",
                "401391792" ~ "vs. NY Liberty")) |>
  
  ggplot(aes(x = sim_value)) +
  geom_density() +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = observed_stat),
    color = "red"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ game_id, scales = "free") + labs(title = "Greatest Streak Statistics for 2022 LV Aces",
  subtitle = "On simulated null distributions",
   x = "Streak Statistics",
  y = "Density") + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
                "401507243" ~ "vs. PHX Mercury")
               ) |>
ggplot(aes(x = sim_value)) +
  geom_density() +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = observed_stat),
    color = "red"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ game_id, scales = "free") + labs(title = "Greatest Streak Statistics for 2023 LV Aces",
                                                subtitle = "On simulated null distributions",
                                                x = "Streak Statistics",
                                                y = "Density") + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```


```{r}
set.seed(619)
sim_results_2024 <- glm_shots_predicted |>
  filter(team_id == 9,
         season == 2024) |>
  arrange(game_id, sequence_number) |>
  group_by(game_id) |>
  summarize(
    observed_stat = phat_Sstreak_Fstreak(scoring_play, 3),
    
    sim_stats = list(
      replicate(
        n_sims,
        phat_Sstreak_Fstreak(
          rbinom(n = n(), size = 1, prob = phat),
          3
        )
      )
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  unnest_wider(sim_stats, names_sep = "_") |>
  rename_with(
    ~ paste0("sim_", seq_along(.)),
    starts_with("sim_stats_")
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    p_value = mean(c_across(starts_with("sim_")) >= observed_stat, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

sim_results_2024 |>
  select(-c(3:10002)) |>
  arrange(p_value)

p.adjust(sim_results_2024$p_value, method = "BH") |>
  cbind(sim_results_2024) |>
  select(-c(4:10003)) |>
  slice_min(p_value, n = 6)

df_shots |>
  filter(team_id == 9,
         season == 2024,
         game_id %in% c(401620311, 
                        401677672)) |>
  group_by(game_id) |>
  arrange(game_id, sequence_number) |>
  summarize(statistics = streak_stats(scoring_play, 3)) |>
  unnest_wider(statistics)

longer_2024 <- sim_results_2024 |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("sim_"),
    names_to = "simulation",
    values_to = "sim_value"
  )

sample_games <- sim_results_2024 |> 
  slice_min(p_value, n = 6) |>
  pull(game_id)

longer_2024 |>
  filter(game_id %in% sample_games) |>
  mutate(game_id = as_factor(game_id),
         game_id = game_id |> recode_values(
                "401620311" ~ "vs. ATL Dream 1",
                "401677672" ~ "vs. MN Lynx",
                "401620252" ~ "vs. PHX Mercury",
                "401721255" ~ "vs. ATL Dream 2",
                "401620309" ~ "vs. LA Sparks",
                "401620263" ~ "vs. IN Fever")
               ) |>
ggplot(aes(x = sim_value)) +
  geom_density() +
  geom_vline(
    aes(xintercept = observed_stat),
    color = "red"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ game_id, scales = "free") + labs(title = "Greatest Streak Statistics for 2024 NY Liberty",
                                                subtitle = "On simulated null distributions",
                                                x = "Streak Statistics",
                                                y = "Density") + theme_minimal() + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# Summarize How Often Streaks Occur

```{r}
glm_shots |>
  group_by(season) |>
  summarize(n_games = n_distinct(game_id),
            num_streaks_3plus = sum(streak_before == "3+"),
            avg_nstreaks = num_streaks_3plus/n_games)

glm_shots |>
  group_by(season) |>
  summarize(n_games = n_distinct(game_id),
            num_missstreaks_3plus = sum(miss_streak_before == "3+"),
            avg_nmissstreaks = num_missstreaks_3plus/n_games)

glm_shots |>
  mutate(streak_before = streak - scoring_play,
         miss_streak_before = miss_streak - (1 - scoring_play)) |>
  group_by(season) |>
  summarize(mean_streak = mean(streak_before),
            mean_missstreak = mean(miss_streak_before)) 

glm_shots |>
  group_by(season, team_id, game_id) |>
  summarize(miss_streaks = sum(as.numeric(miss_streak_before == "3+")),
            make_streaks = sum(as.numeric(streak_before == "3+")))
```
